verdict.rationale: Docs show skills are explicitly harness-agnostic ('Everything in skills/ is the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness') and work across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin, Hermes, OpenCode, and Antigravity, with a documented porting process and a cross-runtime alias path (~/.agents/skills/), and a runtime probe confirms a plain markdown SKILL.md folder installs and reads back cleanly outside vendor lock-in. However, no evidence explicitly names or confirms conformance to the formal 'Agent Skills' open specification (e.g., Anthropic's spec) as opposed to Superpowers' own harness-porting convention. Missing for 10: explicit citation/adoption of the named open Agent Skills spec, and independent third-party confirmation that the folder format is spec-compliant rather than just cross-compatible by convention.
